service: Giovanni in the Cloud area-averaged time series
spatial_processing: NASA area-averaging service over the requested bounding box; not the POWER point extraction or a city-wide measurement. Returned contributing grid-cell coordinates/count are not present in the chart CSV.
retrieval_date_precision: Date only; exact server response time not retained.
acquisition_method: User signed in to the official Giovanni website, generated monthly T2M time series, and downloaded the plot CSV for each requested range. User supplied both files directly to this workspace.

verification_basis.product_units_region: Observed in user-provided successful Giovanni screenshot for 2020; product/version, monthly, K, requested bounding box and date range visible.
verification_basis.long_record: Original generated filename identifies the same product and bounds, 2001-2025 request. User confirmed downloading both. All 11 overlapping values agree exactly.
verification_basis.limitations: Chart exports contain x,y only, not native server metadata. Origin is supported by the observed manual workflow, not by a new authenticated programmatic request, cryptographic NASA signature or retained Harmony job URL.

timestamp_processing.method: Restore the browser-local calendar labels by converting exported UTC timestamps to Asia/Dubai, then normalize the first-of-month labels. This rule is specific to these checksum-verified browser exports, not a general Giovanni API rule.
timestamp_processing.browser_behavior: The deployed frontend parses service timestamps with new Date(t), serializes toISOString(), filters by requested bounds, and downloads the plotted x,y values. NASA averaging-service reference CSV uses timezone-less timestamps. In UTC+04:00 a first-of-month midnight becomes 20:00 UTC on the previous date.
timestamp_processing.certainty_limit: No native response was retained for these specific jobs. The restoration is based on the acquisition timezone, timestamp pattern, deployed frontend logic and NASA service format reference; it is not an independent re-download.

frontend_evidence.exporter: nD/kV and oD/AV: plotted x,y CSV with product/location/request dates in filename

service_csv_format_reference.use: Timestamp-format evidence only. No reference precipitation measurements are used by TrendLens.
